canonical_project: Equinix Cape Town Campus (King Air Industria, two hyperscale data centres)

location.subnational: Western Cape - City of Cape Town

notes: Equinix's Cape Town campus at King Air Industria (Pallotti Rd, Matroosfontein, ~30-acre site adjacent to Cape Town International Airport): City of Cape Town Municipal Planning Tribunal approved the land-use/rezoning application on 14 July 2026 for two hyperscale data centres totalling >120,000 sq m, up to ~160MW (per press ~174MW electricity); dry-air cooling confirmed by Equinix. Objections pending: Legal Resources Centre considering appeal (Business Day 2026-07-20), Foxglove/housing-movement challenge (2026-04-29), Engineering News reports King David Golf Club (site owner) and Equinix had 30 days to respond with City 180 days to decide on the environmental challenge. Equinix also announced (Apr 2026, Bloomberg via MarketScreener) ZAR7.5bn ($396m) for 160MW additional SA capacity incl. this campus. Status: land-use approved, not yet environmental/building-approved or under construction - per methodology Cape Town approvals are staged.
